__doc__: SOT-1459 per-role worker assignment. Editable file (NOT .env). Each harness role maps to an ORDERED PRIORITY CHAIN of workers: index 0 = primary (tried first), the rest = fallback order tried on non-response / usage-limit. Valid roles: task-check | decomposition | implementation | verification | acceptance | github | linear-report. Valid workers: claude | codex | antigravity. A bare string is accepted as a single-element chain (backward compatible). The dispatcher scripts/ai/run_worker.sh <role> reads this chain and invokes each worker's run script (run_codex.sh / run_claude.sh / run_antigravity.sh) in order: if a worker is non-responsive (exit 75) or hits its usage limit, the dispatcher hands off to the NEXT worker in the chain, passing the partial report so work continues. Consecutive invocations of the SAME worker reuse that CLI's session so the conversation/prompt cache stays warm. The former global env kill-switches (ALL_CLAUDE_MODE, WORKER_MODE) have been removed; this file is the single top-level worker selector. The per-worker availability flags (CODEX_DISABLED / ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLED / CLAUDE_DISABLED) and usage-limit cooldown are evaluated per worker, after chain selection. This file is the DEFAULT; a Linear issue can override roles for its own pipeline run with a directive line 'workers: role=worker[>fallback], ...' in its description or a comment (see src/lib/workerRoleDirective.ts and runner-cli resolve-worker-roles). Keys starting with __ are ignored. SOT-1569 (default worker policy): every role's static chain has primary=claude, secondary=codex, tertiary=antigravity (per human directive). SOT-1558 (doer/checker separation) previously set the verification/acceptance chains with a codex primary, then a DYNAMIC variant moved the implementation worker to the BACK of the acceptance chain; both have been REMOVED (per human directive: the dynamic separation that demoted the implementation worker on the acceptance chain is unnecessary), so acceptance/verification now resolve to the same static chain as every other role with no reordering. The SOT-1555 NOT_REQUIRED pin (PIPELINE_PINNED_WORKER) is unaffected: it keeps a non-code task (DOC/REVIEW/PLAN/QUESTION/SECURITY-scan) on ONE AI by moving the pinned worker to the FRONT of its chain.
